subject: Cohost Labs partner sponsorship credits – activation & guardrails
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie@cohostlabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: accelerator@cohostlabs.com
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cohost accelerator — sponsorship credits and basic activation ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the call earlier. Cohost Labs is excited to co-host our spring accelerator (May cohort). We discussed providing a sponsorship pool of $25k in Redwood credits to distribute to accepted startups. Two quick asks so we can finalize the SOW:

- Is Redwood able to issue partner-managed promo codes (single-use) or do we need to handle via API key scoped to an enrollment bucket?
- We need a simple activation CSV or API call so our ops team can onboard winners in bulk.
- Reporting cadence: we prefer weekly spend reports and a consolidated invoice line so we can reconcile.

Attaching the draft SOW and a sample list format. Can you loop in whoever owns partner activation? We’d like credits live by 11 Apr so winners can start trials.

Best,
Sophie Park
Head of Accelerator Partnerships
Cohost Labs

Attachments: Cohost_Sponsorship_Terms_v1.pdf, credit_activation_template.csv

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@cohostlabs.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.inference, ben.carter@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohost accelerator — sponsorship credits and basic activation ask

Hi Sophie — great to connect earlier and congrats on the cohort lineup. Short answers inline below and I’ll loop in ops/legal: 

- Promo surface: We can offer both partner-managed single-use promo codes and a partner activation API. Partner promo codes are easier for one-off enrollments; API gives more automation.
- Activation format: Your sample CSV works. I’ve attached our onboarding checklist we use for SI/accelerator partners.
- Reporting: We can provide weekly spend snapshots and a monthly reconciliation export; billing can either be netted against the committed sponsor amount or sent as a consolidated bill.

Next steps: I’m adding Kimberly (legal/commercial) and Ben (partner ops) to confirm SOW language and activation SLA. If possible, confirm the final list by April 9 so we can meet the Apr 11 activation target.

—Logan
Director, Partnerships (Redwood Inference)

Attachments: cohost_onboarding-checklist.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>, Sophie Park <sophie@cohostlabs.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.inference
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohost accelerator — sponsorship credits and basic activation ask

Hi team — quick legal and ops notes so the SOW reflects what we can commit to: 

1) Spend ceiling and expiry: We need to cap the $25,000 pool with per-credit expiry (90 days from activation) and maximum per-account redemption to avoid abuse. Please confirm if cohort winners will be unique company emails.
2) Data & compliance: We will not ingest any accelerator PII into Redwood systems beyond standard billing/contact info. If Cohost needs audit logs, we can provide redacted spend reports.
3) Activation method: For partner-managed single-use codes, we require a signed CSV template and an activation manifest via our partner portal. For API activation, we need a service account with limited scope — Ben, can you send the API spec?

If Sophie confirms the expiry and one-code-per-company model, I’ll sign off on the SOW and route to DocuSign.

Thanks — Kim
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Sophie Park <sophie@cohostlabs.com>
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 07 Apr 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohost accelerator — sponsorship credits and basic activation ask

Hey all — API spec attached (summary below). Implementation notes: 

- Two activation modes: 1) CSV bulk activation into partner-scoped bucket (preferred for accelerator ops), 2) POST /partner/v1/credits with service-account JWT for automated enrollments.
- Each activation row requires: company_name, contact_email, desired_quota_usd, activation_date, expiry_date, cohort_id.
- Default per-account cap: $2,500 unless overwritten with prior written approval.
- We’ll generate partner promo codes if Cohost prefers single-use codes; they will be one-time use and tied to the contact email.
- Monitoring: weekly export to your Drive folder + webhook for spend threshold alerts (50% and 90%).

I can run a sandbox activation tomorrow (Apr 8) if you can share a sample winner list.

—Ben
Partner Operations Lead

Attachment: credit_activation_template.csv

From: Sophie Park <sophie@cohostlabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 11 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cohost accelerator — sponsorship credits and basic activation ask

Thanks everyone — Cohost confirms:

- We accept the 90-day expiry and the $2,500 per-company cap. Winners are unique company emails.
- We’ll provide the final winners CSV (name, email, desired_quota_usd, cohort_id) by Apr 9 but appreciate the sandbox run on Apr 8 to validate format — Ben, can you confirm sandbox access details?
- We’re okay with weekly redacted spend reports and the webhook alerts. Please route the SOW to DocuSign and mark the activation window for Apr 11 (as discussed).

Attached is the signed SOW (scanned) and a sample winners CSV (redacted). Let us know if any final changes are needed.

Best,
Sophie

Attachments: Cohost_Sponsorship_Terms_v1_signed.pdf, winners_sample_redacted.csv
